svg.title: Figure 90 — Exercise 15.4-1: Four-level population equation
svg.desc: A four-level energy diagram, atom bookkeeping, and the resulting population-difference rate equation show why the stimulated term has no factor of two.
svg.text: Four-level inversion: the lower laser level empties rapidly
Exercise 15.4-1 • derive the rate equation and explain the missing factor of 2

g.data-original-text: <text class="eq" x="842" y="292">W<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="14">i</tspan> = n/(N<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="14">t</tspan>t<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="14">p</tspan>)</text>

g.data-original-text: <text class="text" x="58" y="580">Checks: n = 0 gives relaxation to N<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="11">0</tspan> with lifetime t<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="11">sp</tspan>.</text>

g.aria-label: Steady lasing gives N = Nt and nss = (N0 − Nt)tp/tsp, twice the three-level value.
g.data-original-text: <text class="text" x="58" y="608">Steady lasing gives N = N<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="11">t</tspan> and n<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="11">ss</tspan> = (N<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="11">0</tspan> − N<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="11">t</tspan>)t<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="11">p</tspan>/t<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="11">sp</tspan>, twice the three-level value.</text>
g.title: Steady lasing gives N = Nt and nss = (N0 − Nt)tp/tsp, twice the three-level value.
